description_en: Retrieves the alert data sources associated with an event

parameters.help_en: The globally unique ID of the event

parameters.help_en:
The type of the view.

- 1: The view of all accounts that are managed by the enterprise

威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
